en: Surely you've never, from childhood to now, had a friend of the opposite sex with whom you had no romantic thoughts about each other (and not because either of you grew ugly!), just someone you hung out with purely to muddle through life together eating and waiting to die?

en: 0. When boys get dumped it's different from girls — they don't cry or make a scene, they just carry on with life as if nothing happened, and for quite a while they won't even change their profile picture or clear their chat history.

en: It's only much, much later, one day, that you ask him why he hasn't been in a relationship for so long?

en: He shakes his head — it's not that he doesn't want to, it's just… don't ask.

en: 1. When they look for a girlfriend, they also need a spiritual 'MRI', and they also want to see a bigger world through it.

text: 也有热衷冷暴力，认为只要一个月不回你消息，就代表单方面宣布分手/等你来提的。
en: and there are also those keen on the silent treatment, who believe that not replying to your messages for a month counts as unilaterally declaring a breakup, or waiting for you to bring it up.

en: At least that's how it seems in their eyes — they believe that their 'inability to say no' is also a kind of love.

text: 5.在他们眼里，有一种女生是很可爱的，可爱到：
en: 5. In their eyes, there's a kind of girl who is very lovely, so lovely that:

en: · She really is a good match for me in every respect…

en: Oh well, then why not give being together a try?

text: 哎呀，她如果瘦一点就好了。
en: Oh, if only she were a bit slimmer.

text: 6.他们真要找女朋友，也是想要好好呵护，想要慢慢剥开这份礼物的，那些跟你第一次见面，就急吼吼地跟你表白，紧接着就想跟你开房的。
en: 6. When they genuinely want to find a girlfriend, they also want to cherish her properly, to slowly unwrap this gift — those who confess their feelings to you in a fluster the very first time you meet, and then immediately want to get a hotel room with you,

en: 7. He doesn't not want to be in a relationship — it's just that the person he wants isn't you.

text: 其实，心里也过那么一个极其幼稚的小男孩。
en: actually, deep down there's also an extremely childish little boy.

en: 9. Whatever you want to say, it's best to list it simply and concisely as 1, 2, 3, 4 and tell them.

text: 这类生物，不喜欢你有事要说的时候，跟他打感情牌，兜圈圈。
en: This kind of creature doesn't like it when you have something to say but play the emotional card with him and beat around the bush.

text: 其实，他们既不是盖世英雄，也不是一夜七次狼。
en: Actually, they are neither world-class heroes nor 'seven-times-a-night wolves'.

text: 一、
en: One.

text: “他真是一个幼稚的人啊。
en: ‘He really is such a childish person.

text: ”我时常忍不住这样想。
en: ’I often cannot help but think this.

text: 从在一起的第一天起，我就从未见过他正儿八经的模样，他可以把‘你是不是不爱我了’重复一百八十遍，也可以嘟着嘴撒娇大半天，
en: From the very first day we got together, I had never seen him act serious — he could repeat 'don't you love me anymore' a hundred and eighty times, or pout and act coquettish for half a day,

text: 他喜欢分享一切搞笑的视频和段子，嘻嘻哈哈地将爱情公寓看上一整夜，似乎在他的世界里，没有什么事情是睡一觉不能解决的，如果有，那就睡上一整天。
en: He loves sharing all sorts of funny videos and jokes, and giggling his way through a whole night watching 爱情公寓 — it seems in his world there's nothing that can't be solved by a good sleep, and if there is, then sleep a whole day.

text: 他最喜欢做的事情，大概就是抓拍和截图我各种丑爆了的模样，别人家男朋友的相册里，清一色全是女朋友仙气逼人的模样，而他的相册里，全是我素面朝天蓬头垢面的瞬间，
en: His favourite thing to do is probably capturing and screenshotting all my utterly hideous moments — other people's boyfriends' photo albums are nothing but their girlfriends looking ethereal and goddess-like, whereas his album is full of moments of me barefaced and with messy hair,

text: 他说这样的‘我’，才是最真实的小仙女。
en: He says that this 'me' is the most authentic little fairy.

text: 二、
en: Two.

text: 不仅如此，他还很脆弱，脆弱之余又非常玻璃心，我曾不止一次地惹过他生气，惹到他憋着嘴语无伦次地跺脚，当然，惹急了，他还会止不住的哭。
en: Not only that, he is also very fragile, and on top of being fragile he has a real glass heart — I've provoked his anger more than once, to the point where he'd purse his lips and stamp his feet incoherently; of course, when really pushed, he'd cry uncontrollably.

text: 忘了是哪一次吵架了，我情急之下脱口而出‘分手吧’，本也只是胡乱地吓唬吓唬他，没想到视频里的他突然沉默了起来，而后迅速地低下了头，还未来得及问他什么，便发现对方红了眼眶。
en: I've forgotten which row it was, but in a moment of panic I blurted out 'let's break up' — it was only meant to frighten him a bit, yet unexpectedly, on the video, he suddenly fell silent, then quickly lowered his head, and before I could ask anything, I noticed his eyes had reddened.

text: 明明是他惹我生了气，可看到他那副委屈的模样，又好像所有的错都是因为我。
en: Clearly he was the one who made me angry, yet seeing how aggrieved he looked, it was as if all the fault were mine.

text: 说到这，觉得他不仅玻璃心，还挺爱耍无赖。
en: Speaking of this, I feel he's not only glass-hearted but also rather fond of playing the rogue.

text: 原来，所有的‘男儿有泪不轻弹’都是假的，所有的故作坚强也全都是假的，当男人爱上一个能让自己够肆无忌惮卸下防备的姑娘时，他比女人更容易感伤，
en: It turns out all that 'a real man does not shed tears lightly' is false, and all the feigned strength is false too — when a man falls for a girl who lets him drop his guard without restraint, he becomes even more sentimental than a woman,

text: 只是那些感伤，他不敢，也不愿意透露给无关紧要的旁人看，他只能像个孩子般躲进你的胸膛，贪婪地呼吸你身上的味道，在安稳中释放无声的压力和痛楚。
en: it's just that he dare not, and will not, reveal those sorrows to unimportant onlookers — he can only hide in your bosom like a child, greedily breathing in your scent, releasing his silent pressure and pain in the safety of your presence.

text: 三、
en: Three.

text: 当然，他也非常没有安全感，有时候忘了回信息，他便会一个又一个的电话飙过来，刚一接通电话，那头的声音幽怨又着急，略带埋怨又让人听了不忍心，听他的口气，仿佛我已经消失了一整个世纪。
en: Of course, he also lacks a sense of security terribly — sometimes when I forget to reply, he'll bombard me with call after call, and the moment I pick up, his voice on the other end is full of grievance and urgency, slightly complaining yet impossible to stay angry at; from his tone, you'd think I'd vanished for an entire century.

text: “谁说只有女生才没有安全感？
en: ‘Who says only girls lack a sense of security?

text: 你这是性别歧视！
en: You're being sexist!

text: 他常常理直气壮地对我说，半仰着头斜睨地瞪着我，一副全天下老子最屌的模样，可前脚刚说完那句话，后脚又忍不住抱紧了我。
en: He often says to me with utter conviction, half-tilting his head and glaring at me askance, looking for all the world as if he were the toughest bloke around — yet no sooner has he finished saying that than he can't help but hug me tight.

text: 四、
en: Four.

text: 但就是这样一个幼稚脆弱全然没有安全感的小男生，却从在一起的第一天起，将我规划进了他的未来里。
en: But this childish, fragile, utterly insecure little boy is exactly the one who, from the very first day we got together, planned me into his future.

text: 明明是那么无语到时常令我手足无措的他，却愿意顶着时差的煎熬陪我工作熬夜；
en: Clearly he, who is so exasperating as to often leave me at a loss, is willing to endure the torture of the time difference to keep me company working late into the night;

text: 明明是看上去那么不羁放纵的他，却因为怕我不开心而习惯了足不出户；
en: clearly he, who looks so unrestrained and free, has grown used to never leaving the house for fear of upsetting me;

text: 明明是那么爱打游戏的他，却一边在网吧恶战一边开着语音视频；
en: clearly he, who loves gaming so much, fights fiercely in the internet café while keeping the voice video call on;

text: 明明是…
en: Clearly…

text: 总之，明明是看上去与我全然不匹配的他，却卯足了劲想跟我同手同脚走下去。
en: In short, clearly he, who seems utterly mismatched with me, puts in all his effort to walk in step with me through life.

text: 这大概，才是一个男人在爱情里，最真实的样子。
en: This, more or less, is the truest form of a man in love.

text: 一个男人，年纪再大，骨子里都是个孩子，一个男人，年纪再小，遇到爱情也会学习成长，男人不是一种生物的代名词，没有特定的圈地和划分，深嵌进骨子里的，与女人也一般无二。
en: A man, however old, is at heart a child; a man, however young, will learn and grow when he meets love. 'Man' is not a byword for a kind of creature, there is no fixed territory or division — what is deeply embedded in the bones is no different from a woman's.

text: 看见喜欢的人嘴角便止不住地上扬，空下来便会没来由地思考未来，想钻进对方的怀里贪婪地呼吸，也愿意陪着对方嬉笑怒骂地过下去。
en: Seeing the one they like, the corners of their mouth lift uncontrollably; when they have a free moment they'll ponder the future for no reason; they want to burrow into the other's embrace and breathe greedily, and are willing to spend life with the other through laughter and tears.

text: 那些似乎独属于女人的安全感和小委屈，他们也有，那些似乎只有女人会耍的小心眼和坏脾气，他们也都有，
en: Those feelings of security and small grievances that seem exclusive to women — they have them too; those little schemes and bad tempers that only women seem to play at — they have those too,

text: 当他们遇见让自己怦然心动的姑娘，这些种种的细节，便全部袒露无疑。
en: and when they meet a girl who makes their heart flutter, all these details are laid utterly bare.

text: 五、
en: Five.

text: 在没有遇见他之前，我一直想找个成熟稳重凡事都有规有据的男人，可遇到他之后，我猛然惊觉，在一场天崩地裂的感情里，没有一个男人会永远不温不火，不悲不喜。
en: Before meeting him, I had always wanted to find a mature, steady man who did everything by the book; yet after meeting him, I suddenly realised that in an earth-shattering love, no man stays forever lukewarm, neither sad nor joyful.

text: 其实男人和女人并没有本质上的区别，如果一个女人从不会因为你的过失生气，从不会因为你的暧昧吃醋，从不过问你的过去和曾经，那么，她一定没有爱你到骨子里，
en: In truth there is no essential difference between men and women — if a woman never gets angry at your faults, never feels jealous of your flirtations, never asks about your past and history, then she surely doesn't love you to the bone,

text: 男人亦然。
en: and the same goes for men.

text: 当然了，如果一个男生只知道一味地索取和依赖，从未给你同等的付出和关怀，那么，他可能只是习惯了有你，却不是真真正正地爱惨了你，
en: Of course, if a boy only knows how to take and depend one-sidedly, and never gives you equal effort and care, then he may merely have grown used to having you around, rather than truly, madly loving you,

text: 因为爱上一个人，幼稚会与成熟并肩而行，那些隐藏在内心深处的责任感，便跟着满腔的热火滚滚燃烧起来。
en: because when you fall in love, childishness walks hand in hand with maturity, and the sense of responsibility buried deep within the heart burns up together with the roaring fire of passion.

text: 其实人类是最复杂也是最简单的动物，他们会为了炽热的另一半变得隐忍而退让，在这一点上，男女都一样，希望所有姑娘，都能见到男人这般最真实的模样。
en: In truth, humans are the most complex yet simplest of animals — they become restrained and yielding for the sake of their passionate other half, and on this point men and women are the same. I hope every girl can see this, the truest form of a man.
